meta_description:
393 likes, 32 comments - mombae.blogger on October 24, 2026: "Aarna had the Frozen-themed 7th birthday party of her DREAMS!

She’s been talking about this party non-stop, and now that it’s over, I think she wants to relive it all over again!

Our little Elsa was SO happy to see all her friends, be pampered by everyone and spend the day playing with them. She truly lived her Frozen princess dream.

And if you’re looking for a birthday party venue in Mumbai, @milkywayyplayspace playspace is worth checking out!

It’s an indoor play space with so much for the little ones to do — from the dress-up and makeup corners to the different play areas where they can let their imaginations run wild. The kids had an absolute blast, and the food was good, too! Which, let’s be honest, is always a bonus when you’re hosting a kids’ party.

Beautiful Frozen-themed decor by @events_kiddosense completed the whole setup.

One very happy birthday girl, a room full of happy kids and memories we’ll be talking about for a long time.

Please shower your blessings on her.

#MilkyWayPlaySpace #MumbaiKids #MumbaiBirthdayVenues #FrozenBirthday #SeventhBirthday".
